name: Horse – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose
title: Horse – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose Ornament
story: This horse ornament is for the horse girl who knows exactly where her money went: a sorrel horse leaning over a stall door, and an easy Christmas stocking gift for a rider, a barn friend or a horse mom.

The print is a horse with a blaze, chewing a mouthful of hay over a wooden stall door, under HORSE GIRL in heavy brown slab capitals and BROKE ON PURPOSE beneath it, on a warm cream disc. The art matches our Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose crewneck, so the ornament makes a set with the sweatshirt.

Hay, boarding, farrier and feed add up fast, and every horse person knows it and would do it again. The ornament says it in five words and one very patient horse. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the rider in your life. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: Horses cost a fortune, and every horse girl knows she chose it. The Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints a horse chewing hay over a stall door, so any rider or barn friend gets the joke on the tree at a glance.
